label: VERIFIED
extraction: Santa Method: multi-agent adversarial verification with dual independent reviewers. Four phases: 1) Generator produces deliverable, 2) Two independent reviewers (B and C) with context isolation, identical rubric, same inputs, structured JSON output evaluate in parallel, 3) Verdict gate: both must PASS for NICE (ship), otherwise NAUGHTY with merged issues, 4) Fix cycle: fix all critical issues, re-run both reviewers with fresh agents (no memory carryover), loop up to MAX_ITERATIONS (default 3) then escalate. Rubric design critical: objective pass/fail conditions per criterion (factual accuracy, hallucination-free, completeness, compliance, internal consistency, technical correctness). Three implementation patterns: Claude Code subagents (recommended for true isolation), sequential inline (fallback), batch sampling (10-15% for large batches). Metrics: first-pass rate target >70%, mean iterations <1.5, issue taxonomy distribution, reviewer agreement %, escape rate target 0. Costs ~2-3x generation tokens per cycle.
